definitions.short: Madai , a country of central Asia
definitions.full: H4074. Maday מָדַי proper name, of a people et terr. Medes, Media (Old Persian Mâda Sp APK, Assyrian Madai COT Gloss, and on Genesis 10.. 2 Dl Par. 247 ); — 1 people, as 'son' of Japhet Gen 10:2 (P) = 1Chr 1:5 ; as hostile power Isa 13:17 ; 21:2 ; מָדַי זֶרַע Dan 9:1 ; land and people, מָדַי מַלְכֵי Jer 25:25 (+ עֵילָם מַלְכֵי ), 51:11 , 28 ; מ ׳מַלְכֵי וּפָרַס Dan 8:20 ; compare וּמָדַי מָּרַס Est 1:3 , 14 , 18 , 19 ; 10:2 ; ᵐ5 Μαδαι . 2 of land alone = Media 2Kin 17:6 ; 18:11 (both מָדָ֑י עָרֵי ).
